faqs.question: What does AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex measure?
faqs.answer: This test measures the drug susceptibility of the Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTb) complex to the antibiotic, ethambutol.

faqs.question: Why is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex done?
faqs.answer: • This test is primarily conducted to identify drug susceptibility in tuberculosis cases. • Other reasons include assessing resistance patterns, selecting appropriate antibiotics for treatment, and monitoring treatment effectiveness. • It helps guide clinicians in prescribing suitable medications and combatting multidrug-resistant tuberculosis.

faqs.question: When is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended if you have been diagnosed with tuberculosis or are at risk due to exposure. It is also advised for patients experiencing persistent symptoms despite treatment, individuals with a history of non-compliance to medication, or those requiring modified drug regimens based on resistance profiles.

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may suggest resistance to ethambutol or other anti-TB drugs.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: During this test, a specimen, such as pure culture (MTb complex) bottle or MGIT tube or LJ slant, will be collected and sent to the laboratory.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: • Complete blood count (CBC): This test can provide insights into any systemic effects of tuberculosis infection. • Chest X-ray: This imaging test helps identify abnormalities in the lungs and chest

faqs.question: What is the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Ethambutol Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex also known as?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis Drug Susceptibility Test, Ethambutol Sensitivity Test for Mycobacterium tuberculosis, MTB Antibiogram Test

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis (TB)?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease caused by the bacteria Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body. TB can cause symptoms such as coughing, fever, weight loss, and fatigue. Prompt diagnosis and treatment are essential to prevent complications and stop the spread of the disease.
